segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
My name is Marco.
My name is Kathryn and we're going to the gym today, right Marco?
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，我们今天要去健身房，对吧，马可？

segments.en: That's right.
Today we're going to go to the gym and we're going to try to lose weight or to get in shape.
segments.zh: 今天我们要去健身房，我们将尝试减肥或保持体形。

segments.en: So before we start out though, there is a phrasal verb that we should take a look at.
segments.zh: 所以在我们开始之前，有一个短语动词我们应该看看。

segments.en: So today in Vocabulary Preview, we're looking at this phrase, to work out or working out.
segments.zh: 所以今天在词汇预览中，我们正在研究这句话，锻炼或锻炼。

segments.en: That's right.
So when we go to the gym, this is what we do.
segments.zh: 所以当我们去健身房时，这就是我们所做的。

segments.en: We go there to work out, to exercise or to tone up.
segments.zh: 我们去那里锻炼，锻炼或锻炼身体。

segments.en: This is just a way of saying that I'm going to go somewhere like a gym to exercise myself.
segments.zh: 这只是一种说法，我要去一个健身房去锻炼身体。

segments.en: That's right.
So with that in mind, we're going to go to the gym, we're going to work out and we're going to learn a lot of words today about what exactly goes on in the gym.
segments.zh: 所以考虑到这一点，我们要去健身房，我们要锻炼身体，今天我们将学习很多关于健身房发生的事情的词。

segments.en: Do you want to go catch a movie tonight?
I can't.
I have to go to the gym.
Come on.
You can go tomorrow.
Just skip it today.
It's not as if you're going to get in trouble.
Actually, I will.
I'm working out with a personal trainer that gets on my case if I don't go.
segments.zh: 我请了私教一起练，不去他就会念叨我。

segments.en: I like it because it makes me feel more obligated to go and get healthy.
segments.zh: 我喜欢这样，有人督促我去锻炼、保持健康。

segments.en: That's cool.
Does your personal trainer basically teach you how to work out?
segments.zh: 你的私教会教你怎么锻炼吗？

segments.en: Yeah.
He makes a workout plan depending on the areas I want to work on or the muscles I want to build.
segments.zh: 会。他会根据我想练的部位和想增强的肌肉制定训练计划。

segments.en: Like for example, in order to get better muscle tone in my abs, pecs and biceps, he makes me work out with free weights.
segments.zh: 比如想练出腹肌、胸肌和肱二头肌的线条，他就让我用自由重量器械训练。

segments.en: Then for my quads, calves and hamstrings, I do leg lifts or squats.
segments.zh: 股四头肌、小腿肌肉和大腿后侧肌群则靠抬腿或深蹲来练。

segments.en: Sounds like you're really getting into shape.
segments.zh: 听起来你真练出身材了。

segments.en: All right.
So, now we're back.
Let's take a look at Language Takeaway.
Language Takeaway.
All right.
First of all, in today's dialogue, we heard a lot about this person called a personal trainer.
segments.zh: 首先，在今天的对话中，我们听说了很多关于这个人的人，叫做私人教练。

segments.en: What does a personal trainer do, Marco?
segments.zh: 私人教练是做什么的，马可？

segments.en: So basically, you have a person that is your coach, the person that guides you and teaches you how to work out or what you should do.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，你有一个人是你的教练，指导你并教你如何锻炼或你应该做什么的人。

segments.en: All right.
So, personal means it's just for me.
segments.zh: 所以，个人意味着它只是给我的。

segments.en: This person is only helping me.
A trainer is someone who, like you say, gives me guidance.
segments.zh: 培训师是像你说的那样给我指导的人。

segments.en: So personal trainer is someone who will work with me every day or maybe one time a week to really get the most out of my workout.
segments.zh: 所以私人教练是一个每天或每周与我一起工作的人，以真正充分利用我的锻炼。

segments.en: That's right.
So that is a personal trainer.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个私人教练。

segments.en: And as we said, he's going to help us to build muscle.
segments.zh: 正如我们所说，他将帮助我们锻炼肌肉。

segments.en: We want to build muscle when we go to the gym.
segments.zh: 当我们去健身房时，我们想锻炼肌肉。

segments.en: All right.
So, this is an interesting one because the verb is not to grow or to make.
segments.zh: 所以，这是一个有趣的，因为动词不是成长或制造。

segments.en: The verb is to build.
So, I have muscles, but I want my muscles to get bigger.
segments.zh: 所以，我有肌肉，但我希望我的肌肉变大。

segments.en: So I go to build muscles at the gym.
segments.zh: 所以我去健身房锻炼肌肉。

segments.en: You might even hear this phrase, a bodybuilder.
segments.zh: 你甚至可能听到这句话，健美运动员。

segments.en: So this idea that you make them.
segments.zh: 所以你制作它们的想法。

segments.en: Yeah, exactly.
So you don't get muscle.
You don't create muscle.
You build muscle.
And alongside with muscles, not only do you get them big, but you also get muscle tone.
segments.zh: 除了肌肉，你不仅可以让它们变大，而且你还可以获得肌肉张力。

segments.en: All right.
So muscle tone basically means definition.
segments.zh: 所以肌肉张力基本上意味着定义。

segments.en: So maybe before you start to work out, your body is very soft.
segments.zh: 所以也许在你开始锻炼之前，你的身体很柔软。

segments.en: You can't see the muscles.
Well, when you start to see those muscles, you see the lines in your body.
segments.zh: 好吧，当你开始看到这些肌肉时，你会看到你身体的线条。

segments.en: Your skin gets tighter, not so soft.
segments.zh: 你的皮肤变得更紧，而不是那么柔软。

segments.en: That's called muscle tone.
segments.zh: 这就是所谓的肌肉张力。

segments.en: That's right.
So then you can see the muscles.
That's muscle tone.
And now the muscles that we most commonly go to the gym to work out, we're going to name really quickly and we're going to see where they are.
segments.zh: 现在我们最常去健身房锻炼的肌肉，我们会很快命名，我们将看看它们在哪里。

segments.en: So the first one that we mentioned were abs.
segments.zh: 所以我们提到的第一个是ABS。

segments.en: Okay.
This is an important one, especially if you want to go to the beach.
segments.zh: 这很重要，特别是如果您想去海滩。

segments.en: The abs are located on your stomach.
So you see those kind of rectangles, those squares on your stomach.
segments.zh: 所以你会看到那些矩形，那些在你肚子上的正方形。

segments.en: Those are the abs.
That's right.
And now for guys also, we want to work out our pecs or our pectoral muscles.
segments.zh: 现在对于男人来说，我们也想锻炼我们的胸肌或胸肌。

segments.en: So those are on your chest, below your neck, but above your stomach.
segments.zh: 所以那些在你的胸前，在你的脖子下面，但在你的胃上。

segments.en: That's right.
And another important one on your arm, we have our biceps.
segments.zh: 你手臂上的另一个重要的是，我们有我们的二头肌。

segments.en: All right.
Men usually like to show these off, or at least boys do.
segments.zh: 男人通常喜欢炫耀这些，或者至少男孩喜欢。

segments.en: These are on your arms.
So you know when you make that L shape with your arm and you squeeze like Popeye?
segments.zh: 所以你知道什么时候你用手臂制作那个 L 形状，你像大力水手一样挤压？

segments.en: Those are your biceps.
Those are your biceps.
Exactly.
And now, obviously going down towards our legs now, we have our quad muscles, our quads.
segments.zh: 现在，显然现在向我们的腿下降，我们有我们的股四肌肉，我们的股四头肌。

segments.en: All right.
So those are on the top part of your legs, right Marco?
segments.zh: 所以那些在你腿的顶部，对吧，马可？

segments.en: In front.
In front.
So like on the top of your thigh.
segments.zh: 所以就像在你的大腿上方一样。

segments.en: Exactly.
And now right behind the back part of your leg, you have your hamstrings.
segments.zh: 现在就在你腿后部的后面，你有你的腿筋。

segments.en: Hamstring.
Now you hear about this one a lot because people injure their hamstrings pretty easily in football or in running.
segments.zh: 现在你经常听说这个，因为人们在足球或跑步中很容易伤害他们的腿筋。

segments.en: Yeah, that's right.
Sometimes if you're running and you didn't stretch, your muscles are not warm, you can pull a hamstring.
segments.zh: 有时如果你在跑步并且没有拉伸，你的肌肉不温暖，你可以拉腿筋。

segments.en: All right.
So that hamstring is an important one.
We have one more.
That's right.
We have our calves and these are in the bottom, right above our feet.
segments.zh: 我们有我们的小腿，它们在我们脚上方的底部。

segments.en: So I don't have any muscles except for this one because I ride my bike.
segments.zh: 所以除了这块肌肉，我没有任何肌肉，因为我骑了我的自行车。

segments.en: And when you ride your bike, this gets big.
segments.zh: 当您骑自行车时，这会变得很大。

segments.en: So your calves are that part of your leg above your foot, but below your knee in the back.
segments.zh: 所以你的小腿是你脚上方腿的那部分，但在你的膝盖下方。

segments.en: That's right.
The back part.
Very good.
So all of these muscles, some of the most common ones that we work out.
segments.zh: 所以所有这些肌肉，一些我们锻炼的最常见的肌肉。

segments.en: So now let's move on to some important phrases on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们继续讨论 Fluency Builder 上的一些重要短语。

segments.en: Do you want to go catch a movie tonight?
I can't.
I have to go to the gym.
Come on.
You can go tomorrow.
Just skip it today.
It's not as if you're going to get in trouble.
Actually, I will.
I'm working out with a personal trainer that gets on my case if I don't go.
segments.zh: 我请了私教一起练，不去他就会念叨我。

segments.en: I like it because it makes me feel more obligated to go and get healthy.
segments.zh: 我喜欢这样，有人督促我去锻炼、保持健康。

segments.en: That's cool.
Does your personal trainer basically teach you how to work out?
segments.zh: 你的私教会教你怎么锻炼吗？

segments.en: Yeah.
He makes a workout plan depending on the areas I want to work on or the muscles I want to build.
segments.zh: 会。他会根据我想练的部位和想增强的肌肉制定训练计划。

segments.en: Like, for example, in order to get better muscle tone in my abs, pecs, and biceps, he makes me work out with free weights.
segments.zh: 例如，为了在我的腹肌、胸肌和二头肌中获得更好的肌肉张力，他让我锻炼身体。

segments.en: Then for my quads, calves, and hamstrings, I do leg lifts or squats.
segments.zh: 然后对于我的股四头肌、小腿和腿筋，我会做抬腿或深蹲。

segments.en: Sounds like you're really getting into shape.
segments.zh: 听起来你真练出身材了。

segments.en: So the beginning of the dialogue, the friends were trying to decide what to do.
segments.zh: 所以在对话的开始，朋友们正试图决定做什么。

segments.en: And one friend said, do you want to go catch a movie?
segments.zh: 一位朋友说，你想去看电影吗？

segments.en: That's right.
So to catch a movie.
Do you want to go catch a movie?
It sounds funny because catch means to hold something in your hands after someone throws it.
segments.zh: 这听起来很有趣，因为 Catch 意味着在有人扔掉它后将某物握在手中。

segments.en: So throw and catch.
But here, it doesn't mean to actually hold something in your hands.
segments.zh: 但在这里，它并不意味着实际握在手中。

segments.en: It means do you want to go see a movie?
segments.zh: 这意味着你想去看电影吗？

segments.en: Right.
Exactly.
So it's a very informal, colloquial way of saying, hey, do you want to go to the movies?
segments.zh: 所以这是一种非常随意的口语化的说法，嘿，你想去看电影吗？

segments.en: Do you want to go see a movie?
Maybe not like a serious date or something, just for fun.
segments.zh: 也许不像一个严肃的约会之类的，只是为了好玩。

segments.en: Do you want to go catch a movie?
That's right.
Let's go catch a movie.
All right.
So obviously we can't go to the movies because we got to go to the gym.
segments.zh: 所以显然我们不能去看电影，因为我们要去健身房。

segments.en: And we have to go to the gym because our personal trainer will get on our case.
segments.zh: 我们必须去健身房，因为我们的私人教练会处理我们的案子。

segments.en: The personal trainer will get on my case if I don't go.
segments.zh: 如果我不去，私人教练会处理我的案子。

segments.en: All right.
So someone will get on my case if I don't do this.
segments.zh: 所以如果我不这样做，有人会处理我的案子。

segments.en: So this is an interesting way of saying, my personal trainer will criticize me or will be angry with me if I don't do this.
segments.zh: 所以这是一种有趣的说法，如果我不这样做，我的私人教练会批评我或会生我的气。

segments.en: That's right.
So you can use it with, for example, your parents.
segments.zh: 因此，您可以与您的父母一起使用它。

segments.en: Your parents are always getting on your case because you don't clean your room.
segments.zh: 你的父母总是在处理你的案子，因为你不打扫你的房间。

segments.en: Yeah.
My mom gets on my case when I don't tell her where I'm going when I go out.
segments.zh: 当我外出时我不告诉她我要去哪里时，我妈妈会处理我的案子。

segments.en: So that means to criticize, to give you a hard time, to get angry at you or even maybe yell at you.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着批评，给你一个困难，对你生气，甚至可能对你大喊大叫。

segments.en: But you can change the pronoun.
So he gets on my case, but I can get on your case.
segments.zh: 所以他处理了我的案子，但我可以处理你的案子。

segments.en: That's right.
So remember that someone gets on someone else's case.
segments.zh: 所以请记住，有人会处理别人的案子。

segments.en: That's where the person goes.
And of course, if you want to tell that person to stop bothering you, you just say, get off my case.
segments.zh: 当然，如果你想告诉那个人停止打扰你，你只是说，滚开我的案子。

segments.en: All right.
So he's on her case.
Get off my case.
That's right.
And now to finish things off, the whole reason why we're going to the gym is because we want to get in shape.
segments.zh: 现在完成一些事情，我们去健身房的全部原因是因为我们想保持身材。

segments.en: All right.
Great phrase here to get in shape.
segments.zh: 伟大的短语在这里塑造。

segments.en: This is something a lot of people like to do in the new year.
segments.zh: 这是很多人在新的一年里喜欢做的事情。

segments.en: So they say, okay, it's a new year.
segments.zh: 所以他们说，好吧，这是新的一年。

segments.en: I want a new body.
I'm going to get in shape.
That means I will lose weight, build some muscle and start to feel good.
segments.zh: 这意味着我会减肥，锻炼肌肉并开始感觉良好。

segments.en: That's right.
So we want to get in shape.
Very good.
Let's listen to our dialogue one last time.
segments.zh: 我们最后再听一遍对话。

segments.en: Do you want to go catch a movie tonight?
I can't.
I have to go to the gym.
Come on.
You can go tomorrow.
Just skip it today.
It's not as if you're going to get in trouble.
Actually, I will.
I'm working out with a personal trainer that gets on my case if I don't go.
segments.zh: 我请了私教一起练，不去他就会念叨我。

segments.en: I like it because it makes me feel more obligated to go and get healthy.
segments.zh: 我喜欢这样，有人督促我去锻炼、保持健康。

segments.en: That's cool.
Does your personal trainer basically teach you how to work out?
segments.zh: 你的私教会教你怎么锻炼吗？

segments.en: Yeah.
He makes a workout plan depending on the areas I want to work on or the muscles I want to build.
segments.zh: 会。他会根据我想练的部位和想增强的肌肉制定训练计划。

segments.en: Like for example, in order to get better muscle tone in my abs, pecs and biceps, he makes me work out with free weights.
segments.zh: 比如想练出腹肌、胸肌和肱二头肌的线条，他就让我用自由重量器械训练。

segments.en: Then for my quads, calves and hamstrings, I do leg lifts or squats.
segments.zh: 股四头肌、小腿肌肉和大腿后侧肌群则靠抬腿或深蹲来练。

segments.en: Seems like you're really getting into shape.
Going to the gym, getting a personal trainer, what do you think?
segments.zh: 去健身房，找私人教练，你怎么看？

segments.en: Is it a good idea or a bad idea?
segments.zh: 这是一个好主意还是一个坏主意？

segments.en: I think for some people who have a hard time getting motivated, so people who don't like to go to the gym, it's a great idea because having another person push you can really help.
segments.zh: 我认为对于一些很难获得动力的人来说，所以不喜欢去健身房的人，这是一个好主意，因为有另一个人推动你真的可以提供帮助。

segments.en: I think for other people who are already pushing themselves, it's not as helpful.
segments.zh: 我认为对于其他已经在推动自己的人来说，这没有多大帮助。

segments.en: I think also if you just start out going to the gym, I think you should get a personal trainer for the first couple of weeks because you really have to understand and learn what you're doing and the purpose of that exercise and figure out how many sets, how many repetitions.
segments.zh: 我也认为，如果你刚开始去健身房，我认为你应该在前几周找个私人教练，因为你真的必须了解和了解你在做什么以及练习的目的，并弄清楚有多少组，有多少重复。

segments.en: This is very important because some people just go and they overwork it.
segments.zh: 这非常重要，因为有些人只是去工作过度。

segments.en: They do and they don't know how to use the machines or the weights.
segments.zh: 他们这样做了，他们不知道如何使用机器或重量。

segments.en: You can actually harm yourself.
segments.zh: 你实际上可以伤害自己。

segments.en: You can pull a hamstring or something if you don't know what you're doing.
segments.zh: 如果你不知道自己在做什么，你可以拉腿筋什么的。

segments.en: For people who've never learned how to exercise, maybe it's a good idea like you say.
segments.zh: 对于从未学过锻炼的人来说，也许这是一个好主意，就像你说的那样。

segments.en: It's a very interesting thing.
segments.zh: 这是一件非常有趣的事情。

segments.en: Actually gyms as well, very popular nowadays, especially with the holidays passing.
segments.zh: 实际上也是健身房，现在很受欢迎，尤其是假期过去了。

segments.en: People gain some holiday weight.
segments.zh: 人们增加了一些假期体重。

segments.en: You got to go back to the gym to lose that weight.
segments.zh: 你必须回到健身房减肥。

segments.en: That's right.
Let us know.

If so, what parts of your body do you like to focus on?
